findings.question: q-comprehension-skills-choosing-a-title-0017
findings.quote: This treats a proposal as a decision. The painting is kept for a later budget. Check what the committee decides this term.
findings.problem: The note treats the writer's recommendation as a reported committee decision. The passage says the committee should keep the painting proposal for a later budget and the roof should receive attention first; it never reports a vote or final decision. A student following the check cannot find what the committee actually decides this term.
findings.fix: Say that the writer recommends repairing the roof first and postponing painting. Ask students to check whether the passage reports a decision or gives a recommendation.
